chunks: He (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted, is not unjust to His servants, and He is more Knowing of what is in the chest, and He has counted every thing with a count, and He has counted every thing in the Imam, so whoever attains the Imam from them has attained the Imamate, and whoever does not attain him has gone far astray.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Imam in attaining divine guidance according to Shia theology?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq utilizes this hadith to establish the Imam as the comprehensive repository of divine knowledge (*al-Imam al-Mu'izz*), reinforcing the Shia doctrine that the Imam is the necessary medium for interpreting the Quran and preserving the faith. This assertion underscores the theological principle that divine justice necessitates the provision of an infallible guide, making adherence to the specific Imam of the time a condition for salvation and a safeguard against misguidance.
